tasks.title: Recover accuracy logs from raw generator/judge logs
tasks.objective: Sort raw generator.log and judge.log by timestamp, split into 3 per-run files per role (6 files total), compute per-run accuracy excluding errors, and save results.json

factSources.description: raw_logs/generator.log - 30 generator events with timestamp, question_id, prediction fields
raw_logs/judge.log - 30 judge events with timestamp, question_id, target fields

outputContracts.description: 6 per-run JSONL files (3 generator, 3 judge) each with exactly 10 lines sorted by timestamp ascending, compact JSON with no extra whitespace, key order: timestamp, question_id, prediction/target

evidenceRefs.artifactRef: user request in conversation: task description with exact schemas

outputContracts.description: results.json with runs array containing run_index, correct, total, accuracy (null if total=0), double precision, rounded half-up to 2 decimals

evidenceRefs.artifactRef: user request in conversation: results.json schema example

facts.statement: generator.log contains 30 events with timestamp, question_id, prediction fields; each of 10 question_ids has exactly 3 events
judge.log contains 30 events with timestamp, question_id, target fields; each of 10 question_ids has exactly 3 events

nodes.contextSummary: Write Python script to split 30 events per role into 3 per-run files (10 each) based on per-question_id timestamp ordering, then compute accuracy per run excluding errors, output 6 JSONL files + results.json
